svg.title: URTC-SMART-RACK architecture
svg.desc: URTC-SMART-RACK is pure C tested on a computer: it frames and checks the serial messages of the rack, validates each command and watches the link, keeps an inventory of which tool is in which slot and the wear of each head, and decides when a tool should be pre-heated and to what temperature. No PCB exists yet, so none of it has driven a real pin, heater or CAN transceiver.

svg.text: The logic and the serial protocol of a rack that stores URTC tool heads, tracks their use and pre-heats the next tool.
